timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹606.57 Cr, net profit ₹51.11 Cr.
Ugro Capital reported Q4FY26 PAT of ₹51.1 Cr and full-year FY26 PAT of ₹174.8 Cr.
Ugro Capital released its Q4FY26 investor presentation detailing the execution of its strategic realignment and expansion in focus verticals.
Ugro Capital Limited submitted audio recording of earnings conference call on audited FY/Q4 2025-26 results via Investor Relations link on 21 April 2026, signed by Satish Kumar and K. Chelladurai.
Ugro Capital reported its Q4FY26 earnings call details, highlighting execution of its strategic realignment towards EM LAP and embedded finance.
Ugro Capital allotted listed commercial papers worth ₹14.38 Cr on April 27, 2026, maturing on October 23, 2026.
Ugro Capital's NCDs (ISIN INE583D07463 & INE583D07455) were suspended from trading effective May 12, 2026, due to maturity.
Ugro Capital allotted ₹13.41 Cr of listed commercial papers on 12 May 2026, redeemable 12 November 2026.
Ugro Capital allotted listed NCDs worth ₹200 Cr on May 26, 2026, carrying a coupon of 9.75% p.a. maturing in November 2027.
Ugro Capital clarified media reports regarding promoter compensation, governance practices, and personal guarantees.
UGRO Capital Limited held its 33rd AGM on May 29, 2026, via video conferencing with M/s Pankaj Nigam & Associates as scrutinizers.
22 Oct 2026: UGRO Capital said NCLT Mumbai admitted its scheme petition to merge Profectus Capital into itself on 9 Oct 2026, with final hearing fixed for 20 Nov 2026.
